names.why: Lakes, a well and a salt flat (about 7 of 27) are a stretch, but rivers, streams and waterfalls dominate and no single word is clearer.
About 7 of 24 videos are deserts, dunes, salt flats, a snowfield and a crater; 'Countryside' suggests farmland only.

notes: No clear misplacement. Off-topic for any new group, left where they are: 254 'earth' (desk globe) and 5422 'recycling' (park bin), both in Countryside. 4555 'pine' (cable car over snowy conifers) is fine in Mountains by clip.
